meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会调用 Centinela(QA) agent 做深度安全审计,检查 OWASP Top 10、认证授权、硬编码密钥、依赖 CVE 等,给出结论并把报告写入 docs/reviews/ 目录。
howto.when: 在发布前、涉及认证授权或数据处理的重大改动之后、新增依赖或外部集成等时机触发,也可用于定期复查代码库。

say.text: 对整个 src/ 跑一次安全审计
say.note: 不指定范围时默认审计整个 src/ 目录

say.text: 审计 src/auth/ 和 src/api/ 这两个目录
say.note: 只审计指定目录,报告存到 docs/reviews/

say.text: 扫一下代码里的硬编码密钥和依赖漏洞
say.note: 它只记录问题,不会自动修改代码

howto.what_en: After install, Claude runs a deep security audit via the Centinela (QA) agent: OWASP Top 10, auth, secrets, dependency CVEs, then issues a verdict and writes the report to docs/reviews/.
howto.when_en: Triggered before a release, after significant changes touching auth or data handling, when adding dependencies or integrations, and for periodic reviews.

say_en.text: Run a full security audit on src/
say_en.note: Defaults to the whole src/ directory

say_en.text: Scan for hardcoded secrets and dependency CVEs
say_en.note: It only documents findings, never fixes them
